title: LabelSelector
description: A label selector filtering pods or namespaces by their labels. Combines matchLabels equality requirements with matchExpressions set-based requirements using AND logic.

matchLabels.description: Key-value pairs that must all match on the target resource labels.

matchExpressions.description: Set-based requirements combined with AND logic.

key.description: Label key the selector applies to.

operator.description: Relationship between the key and values.
